# Learning report, batch 0

Trained on 24 matches (24 new in this batch). Variables in use: 17; build variables from 60 matches, interactions from 40.

## 1. The honest test

**Not yet better than strength alone: treat the curves as noise.** Held-out accuracy (matches held out whole), log loss in brackets (lower is better):

- strength only: all 74% (0.534), 0-5 min 81% (0.441), 5-10 min 79% (0.482), 10-15 min 73% (0.566), 15-end min 62% (0.67)
- glass box: all 74% (0.636), 0-5 min 81% (0.506), 5-10 min 83% (0.379), 10-15 min 73% (0.685), 15-end min 57% (1.002)
- black box: all 76% (0.932), 0-5 min 85% (0.609), 5-10 min 84% (0.649), 10-15 min 72% (1.054), 15-end min 61% (1.499)

## 2. What it leans on

- **morale_diff** 1.648: own minus enemy morale summed over players (boosts +, death penalty -)
- **knights_diff** 1.26: own minus enemy pit knights alive
- **bodyguard_diff** 0.898: own minus enemy Bodyguard alive
- **flag_lead** 0.321: seconds up (+) or down (-) on flags: enemy's response minus own on the next capture exchange
- **lord_damage_diff** 0.292: own minus enemy Lord damage dealt so far (the 28:00 tiebreak; players can't see it)
- **stand** 0.206: who holds the flag stand: 1 own, 0 nobody, -1 enemy
- **pit_pressure_diff** 0.199: own players in the enemy pit minus enemy players in the own pit
- **archers_diff** 0.157: own minus enemy pit archers alive
- **spike_killable_diff** 0.131: enemy minus own players within one spike of the other side (DP stacking; 0 unless a spike build is involved)
- **boost_clock** 0.105: seconds until the stand holder's next boost (+ if own boost is coming, - if the enemy's, 0 nobody)
- **main_diff** 0.104: own minus enemy players in each team's main group
- **down_diff_s** 0.103: enemy minus own seconds until all dead players are back (+ = the enemy has more time down)

**Surprises** (moments where the held-out model was most confident about the team that went on to lose; each points to something the variables don't capture yet):

- hdm v HC (28447c4a) at 23:00: a model that never saw this match gave HC 1.3%, and HC won. Why it thought so: morale_diff -47.6, team strength -41.8, knights_diff +41.6, bodyguard_diff +34.2, lord_damage_diff -32.1
- hdm v Men (0f1fd794) at 24:00: a model that never saw this match gave Men 1.5%, and Men won. Why it thought so: bodyguard_diff -44.7, pit_pressure_diff -24.1, flag_lead -12.2, morale_diff +11.0, main_diff -7.5

- OG v cope (84586253) at 15:45: a model that never saw this match gave cope 7.1%, and cope won. Why it thought so: archers_diff -32.1, team strength -21.2, pit_pressure_diff -8.5, stand +7.0, flag_lead -2.8
- Team v push (2df9b7fd) at 21:45: a model that never saw this match gave push 85.4%, and push lost. Why it thought so: team strength -48.4, knights_diff +39.6, spike_killable_diff +35.7, morale_diff +28.3, pit_pressure_diff +18.1
